subject: Function-identifier
notes: SR7 (cite.py --check 8.4.3.2.3 'The word OMITTED shall not be specified if intrinsic-function-name-1 is specified' -> OK §8.4.3.2.3 7)). The grammar admits OMITTED as a superset functionArgument, and BindArgOperand rejects it with COBOL1544 for every intrinsic. User functions bind OMITTED through their own arm in UdfActivate, before BindArgOperand is reached. Probe out/probe/function-identifier/p11_sr7.cob FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(OMITTED) -> COBOL1544. conformance:cases/8.4.3.2-Function-identifier/func-omitted-arg (MAX(OMITTED, 4)) expects COBOL1544 at 2014 and 2023. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 1985 (Amendment 1), 2002, 2014, 2023 - applies to every function-identifier.
